notes.title: Hidden Boxes out now!
notes.notes:
Hidden Boxes is now out!

Hidden Boxes is a classic prop hunt game where seekers try to find props before time runs out. Matches can accommodate up to eight players, offering multiple customizable match settings for players to choose from.

If you have found a bug or a missing feature, please leave a comment on [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2604980/discussions/]community discussions![/url][/b]
